def factor_stress_amplified_price_volume_corr(df):
    """Price-volume demand confirmation amplified by short-term volatility stress."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    open_ = df_copy["open"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]

    # Primary mechanism: rolling correlation between price and volume changes
    close_ret = close.pct_change()
    vol_ret = volume.replace(0, np.nan).pct_change()
    corr = close_ret.rolling(30, min_periods=30).corr(vol_ret)
    corr = corr.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    # Secondary modifier: short-term volatility stress from tail-risk parent
    intraday_ret = close / open_ - 1.0
    past_vol = intraday_ret.rolling(60, min_periods=20).std().shift(1)
    vol_mean = intraday_ret.rolling(120, min_periods=30).std().shift(1)
    vol_stress = past_vol / vol_mean.replace(0, np.nan)
    vol_stress = vol_stress.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    factor = corr * vol_stress
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_stress_amplified_price_volume_corr"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_stress_amplified_price_volume_corr"]
description: Preserves the primary price-volume demand-confirmation mechanism from parent alpha-composite-gen0-B (rolling correlation of price and volume changes) and borrows one lightweight volatility-stress amplifier from tail-risk-0002 (short-term realized intraday volatility relative to longer-term baseline). The stress multiplier emphasizes periods when price-volume synchronicity is more informative, improving stability without adding a separate alpha source.
